tracking_rule: The V-split in cloven hoof prints always points in the direction of animal movement. Follow split prints to intercept active grazing corridors.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: High ridge elevation transitions along sunlit northern slopes.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Sheltered creek beds and pine valley brush to escape deep snow drifts.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Open scrub clearings between 07:00 and 11:00; slow meandering herd pattern.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: Lakeshore riverbanks and willow fringes near water sources.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Dense hemlock and spruce canopies for thermal bedding cover.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Agricultural grass corridors and lake marsh edges.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: Alpine meadows and highland scree plateaus.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: South-facing lower foothills and grassy river bottoms.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Large open plateaus; bulls feed in perimeter meadows while cows graze center.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: Wet peatland marshes, shallow lakes, and birch flats.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Subalpine river valleys with willow thickets for winter browse.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Submerged vegetation and willow shrub corridors.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: Coastal sedge flats and breeze-cooled shore terraces.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Deep-forest windbreak hollows with shallow snowpack.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Expansive coastal grasslands; herds graze in line formations.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: Exposed high crags, rocky saddles, and wind-scoured ridgelines.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Lower south-facing alpine cliffs where wind strips away snow.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Steep alpine tundra slopes with escape cliffs within 50 meters.

seasonal_corridors.summer_trail: High ridge passes and game trail choke points.
seasonal_corridors.winter_trail: Frozen river drainages and low valley deer yards.
seasonal_corridors.grazing_area: Territory patrol perimeter; pack travels 8-15km between kills.
